lesson.intro: Los presentes en ingles no se eligen por cuando pasa sino por como ves la accion: como algo habitual o permanente (Present Simple) o como algo en curso, temporal o en cambio (Present Continuous). Ademas, un grupo de verbos - los de estado - casi nunca se usan en -ing. Domina estas tres ideas y controlas la mayoria de los errores de nivel B1.

sections.heading: 1 - Present Simple: cuando se usa
sections.body:
Usa el Present Simple para lo que es estable, repetido o programado:

  • Rutinas y habitos: every day, usually, on Mondays, twice a week.
  • Hechos y verdades generales: ciencia, naturaleza, cosas que no cambian.
  • Horarios y programaciones (trenes, cines, clases), aunque se refieran al futuro.
  • Instrucciones, recetas y procesos paso a paso.
  • Estados permanentes: donde vives, en que trabajas, que idiomas hablas.
examples: I get up at seven every day.
First you break the eggs, then you add the flour.
She works in a bank and speaks three languages.

sections.heading: 2 - Present Simple: como se forma
sections.body:
Afirmativa: verbo en forma base. Con he / she / it se anade -s.

  • -s normal: work → works.
  • +es tras -o, -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x: go → goes, watch → watches, finish → finishes.
  • consonante + y → -ies: study → studies; vocal + y no cambia: play → plays.
  • irregular: have → has.

Negativa: don't / doesn't + base (el verbo principal nunca lleva -s).

Preguntas: Do / Does + sujeto + base. Con who/what como sujeto no se usa do: Who lives here?

sections.heading: 3 - Present Continuous: cuando se usa
sections.body:
Usa am/is/are + -ing para lo que esta en movimiento:

  • Accion ahora mismo: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
  • Situacion temporal alrededor de ahora, aunque no en este segundo: this week, these days (I'm reading a great book).
  • Situaciones que cambian o evolucionan: get, become, improve, increase, rise, grow.
  • Planes y citas futuras ya acordadas: tomorrow, next week.
  • Con always / constantly para quejarse de algo repetido y molesto.
examples: I'm staying with friends this week.

sections.heading: 4 - Present Continuous: como se forma
sections.body:
am / is / are + verbo-ing. Ortografia del -ing:

  • general: work → working.
  • termina en -e muda → se quita: make → making, write → writing.
  • una silaba consonante-vocal-consonante → se dobla la ultima consonante: run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming.
  • en ingles britanico tambien se dobla la -l: travel → travelling.
  • termina en -ie → -ying: lie → lying, die → dying.
  • termina en -y o -ee no cambia: study → studying, see → seeing.

Negativa: 'm not / isn't / aren't + -ing. Pregunta: Am/Is/Are + sujeto + -ing.

sections.heading: 5 - Marcadores de tiempo y adverbios de frecuencia
sections.body:
Senales de Present Simple: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never, every day/week, on Mondays, once a week, how often...?

Senales de Present Continuous: now, right now, at the moment, at present, currently, today, this week, these days, nowadays, Look!, Listen!

Posicion de los adverbios de frecuencia: antes del verbo principal (I always walk), pero despues del verbo be (I am always late).

Ojo: these days / nowadays / currently pueden ir con Simple (habito actual) o con Continuous (tendencia que cambia), segun el sentido.
examples: At the moment I'm staying at a hotel.
Tom always walks to school. · He is always late.

sections.heading: 6 - Verbos de estado (stative): no van en -ing
sections.body:
Describen estados, no acciones: normalmente no se usan en Continuous, aunque el momento sea ahora (British Council). Categorias:

  • Pensamiento / opinion: know, believe, understand, think (=opinar), mean, remember, agree, doubt, recognise, suppose.
  • Emociones / preferencias: like, love, hate, prefer, want, wish, need.
  • Sentidos / percepcion: see, hear, smell, taste, seem, appear, look (=parecer), sound.
  • Posesion / medida: have (=tener), own, belong, possess, contain, cost, weigh, measure.
  • Otros: be, matter, depend, fit, involve.
examples: I know the answer. (NO: I am knowing)
She wants a coffee. (NO: she is wanting)

sections.heading: 7 - Verbos que cambian de significado
sections.body:
Algunos verbos son estado o accion segun lo que signifiquen (British Council):

  • think: opinion → I think it's nice (estado) / reflexionar → I'm thinking about it (accion).
  • have: posesion → I have a car / actividad → I'm having lunch, a shower, a good time.
  • see: percibir o entender → I see what you mean / quedar con alguien → I'm seeing the dentist tomorrow.
  • taste, smell: percepcion → The soup tastes salty / accion voluntaria → The chef is tasting the soup.
  • look: parecer → You look tired / mirar → I'm looking at the photos.
  • be: cualidad → He is kind / conducta puntual → He is being rude today.
  • weigh: medida → It weighs 2 kg / accion → The grocer is weighing the fruit.
examples: I think you're right. - Hold on, I'm thinking.
We have a dog. - We're having a party.
I see the problem. - I'm seeing a client at 5.

sections.heading: 8 - Elegir Simple o Continuous
sections.body:
Preguntate: es habito, verdad o algo permanente? → Simple. Es algo en curso, temporal, en cambio o un plan acordado? → Continuous.

Futuro: horario fijo (trenes, cine, clases) → Simple (The film starts at 8); cita o plan personal → Continuous (I'm seeing a film tonight).

Contrastes tipicos: I work in Madrid (siempre) / I'm working from home this week (temporal); What do you do? (profesion) / What are you doing? (ahora).
examples: Normally I cycle to work, but this week I'm taking the bus.
She comes from Italy but she's living in Spain now.
The shop opens at 9. - I'm opening a new shop next month.

mistakes: NO: I am agreeing with you. -> SI: I agree with you.
NO: She is having a nice car. -> SI: She has a nice car.
NO: He go to school by bus. -> SI: He goes to school by bus.
NO: They are knowing the truth. -> SI: They know the truth.
NO: Look! It rains. -> SI: Look! It's raining.
NO: I'm liking this song. -> SI: I like this song.
NO: What means this word? -> SI: What does this word mean?

questions.prompt: The museum ___ at 9 a.m. and closes at 6 p.m.
questions.explanation: Horario fijo -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: I usually ___ to work by bus.
questions.explanation: Habito con 'usually'; con 'I' no se anade -s.
Verdad general de la naturaleza -> Present Simple.
Estado permanente / habilidad -> Simple, 3a persona -s.

questions.prompt: According to the timetable, our train ___ at 7:45 tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Horario programado, aunque sea futuro -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: First you ___ the eggs, then you add the flour.
questions.explanation: Instrucciones de una receta -> Present Simple.
Rutina (every weekend) -> Simple, 3a persona -s.
Verdad general sobre una especie; sujeto plural, sin -s.

questions.prompt: The cinema website says the film ___ at 8 p.m.
questions.explanation: Programacion anunciada -> Present Simple.
Preferencia habitual -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Every December, they ___ to the mountains.
questions.explanation: Habito anual (every December) -> Simple; sujeto plural.

questions.prompt: The Amazon River ___ into the Atlantic Ocean.
questions.explanation: Hecho geografico permanente -> Present Simple, 3a persona -s.

questions.prompt: My sister ___ yoga every morning before breakfast.
questions.explanation: Rutina diaria (every morning) -> Present Simple, 3a persona: do -> does.

questions.prompt: The supermarket ___ at 10 p.m. from Monday to Saturday.
questions.explanation: Horario fijo del negocio -> Present Simple, 3a persona -s.

questions.prompt: Maria ___ in Madrid all year round, unlike her sister who travels a lot for work.
questions.explanation: Estado permanente (donde vive), reforzado por 'all year round' -> Present Simple, no Continuous (que sugeriria algo temporal).

questions.prompt: You ___ the pasta for ten minutes, then you drain it.
questions.explanation: Instrucciones paso a paso (receta) -> Present Simple; con 'you' no se anade -s.
Verdad cientifica general -> Present Simple; sujeto plural, sin -s.

questions.prompt: Look! It's raining, but it never ___ here in summer.
questions.explanation: Contraste: 'it's raining' describe el momento (Continuous), pero 'never...in summer' es un habito general -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: The library ___ (open) at 8 a.m. on weekdays.
questions.explanation: Horario fijo del edificio -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: We ___ (visit) our grandparents every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Rutina semanal (every Sunday); con 'we' no se anade -s.

questions.prompt: Completa: According to the schedule, the plane ___ (take off) at 6:30 tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Horario programado, aunque la accion sea futura -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: First you ___ (chop) the onions, then you fry them.
questions.explanation: Instrucciones de una receta, paso a paso -> Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: The Earth ___ (go) around the Sun.
questions.explanation: Hecho cientifico permanente -> Present Simple, 3a persona -es.
Preferencia permanente en negativo -> auxiliar 'doesn't' + verbo base.

questions.prompt: Completa: Do you ___ (speak) any other languages?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre un estado permanente (idiomas que hablas); tras 'Do you' va el verbo base.

questions.prompt: Completa: My brother never ___ (drive) to work; he takes the train.
questions.explanation: Habito habitual con 'never'; el verbo queda en forma afirmativa, 3a persona -s.

questions.prompt: Completa: Shops in this town usually ___ (close) early on Sundays.
questions.explanation: Horario habitual; sujeto plural 'shops', sin -s.
Verdad cientifica -> Present Simple, 3a persona -es.

questions.prompt: Completa: I ___ (not/work) on Fridays; it's my day off.
questions.explanation: Rutina laboral en negativo; con 'I' se usa 'don't' + verbo base.

questions.prompt: Completa: The final step: you ___ (pour) the mixture into the mould and leave it to set.
questions.explanation: Instrucciones de un proceso paso a paso -> Present Simple, sujeto 'you'.

questions.prompt: Completa: This company ___ (export) coffee to more than twenty countries.
questions.explanation: Hecho/estado permanente de la empresa -> Present Simple, 3a persona -s.

questions.prompt: Completa: The museum ___ (not/allow) photos inside the main hall.
questions.explanation: Norma/estado permanente en negativo -> 'doesn't' + verbo base.

questions.prompt: Completa: What time does the shop ___ (open) on Saturdays?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre un horario habitual; tras el auxiliar 'does' va el verbo base, sin -s.

questions.prompt:
Laura goes swimming every week. (USUALLY)
Rewrite: Laura ___ swimming.
questions.explanation: El adverbio de frecuencia 'usually' se coloca antes del verbo principal en Present Simple para expresar un habito.
'Never' ya tiene sentido negativo, asi que el verbo va en forma afirmativa (smokes), no con 'doesn't'.

questions.prompt:
The gym is open 24 hours a day. (NEVER)
Rewrite: The gym ___ closed.
questions.explanation: Con el verbo 'be', el adverbio de frecuencia va despues de 'is'; describe un hecho permanente sobre el horario.

questions.prompt:
This bakery only bakes fresh bread in the morning. (DOESN'T)
Rewrite: This bakery ___ bread in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 'Only in the morning' limita la accion a esa franja horaria, asi que se puede inferir que no ocurre por la tarde -> 'doesn't' + verbo base.

questions.prompt:
Anna has a shower every morning. (USUALLY)
Rewrite: Anna ___ a shower in the morning.
questions.explanation: El adverbio de frecuencia va antes del verbo principal; 'have' cambia a 'has' en 3a persona.

questions.prompt:
This factory produces two thousand cars a month. (DOES)
Rewrite: How many cars ___ this factory produce a month?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre una cantidad habitual/fija -> se usa el auxiliar 'does' en presente simple, 3a persona.

questions.prompt:
Every summer, my uncle only grows vegetables in his garden. (DOESN'T)
Rewrite: My uncle ___ flowers in his garden.
questions.explanation: 'Only' indica que las verduras son lo unico que cultiva, asi que se puede inferir que no cultiva flores -> 'doesn't' + verbo base.

questions.prompt:
Every winter, my grandmother makes soup for the whole family. (ALWAYS)
Rewrite: My grandmother ___ soup for the whole family in winter.
questions.explanation: 'Always' se coloca antes del verbo principal para expresar una rutina repetida.

questions.prompt: Completa: She ___ (go) to the gym on Mondays.
questions.explanation: Tras -o se anade -es: goes.
Consonante + y -> -ies: studies.
Tras -sh se anade -es: finishes.

questions.prompt: Completa: My sister ___ (watch) TV after dinner.
questions.explanation: Tras -ch se anade -es: watches.
Pregunta en 3a persona: Does + sujeto + verbo base (sin -s).
Sujeto plural -> don't + base.
3a persona singular -> doesn't + base.
Pregunta con 'she' -> does + base.
Pregunta con 'you' -> Do + base.

options: She is drink coffee every day.
questions.explanation: 3a persona con -s y el complemento de tiempo al final.

questions.prompt: Completa: He ___ (fly) to London twice a year.
questions.explanation: Consonante + y -> -ies: flies.
'have' es irregular en 3a persona: has.
3a persona singular (he/she/it) + -s: works.

questions.prompt: My aunt ___ the dishes after dinner.
questions.explanation: Tras -sh se anade -es: washes (no 'washs').

questions.prompt: The cat ___ mice in the garden.
questions.explanation: Tras -ch se anade -es: catches (no 'catchs').
Vocal + y no cambia: solo se anade -s (buys), no 'buies' ni 'buyes'.

questions.prompt: The baby ___ a lot at night.
questions.explanation: Consonante + y -> -ies: cries (no 'crys').
Sujeto plural (your parents) -> Do + verbo base, sin -s.
Sujeto 3a persona singular (she) -> Does + verbo base, sin -s.

questions.prompt: He ___ spicy food; it's too strong for him.
questions.explanation: Negativa 3a persona singular: doesn't + verbo base (el verbo principal nunca lleva -s en negativa).

questions.prompt: We ___ have breakfast together on weekdays.
questions.explanation: Sujeto plural (we) -> don't + verbo base.
Cuando 'who' es el sujeto de la pregunta, no se usa el auxiliar do/does; el verbo principal lleva -s (speaks).
Aqui 'this word' (3a persona singular) es el sujeto real de la pregunta, no 'what'; por eso si se necesita el auxiliar does.
'have' es irregular en 3a persona singular: has, nunca 'haves'.
Pregunta 3a persona singular: Does + sujeto + verbo base (sin -s en 'like').
Sujeto plural (they) -> don't + verbo base, sin -s.

questions.prompt: Completa: He ___ (fix) computers for a living.
questions.explanation: Tras -x se anade -es: fixes.

questions.prompt: Completa: The train ___ (pass) through three cities.
questions.explanation: Tras -ss se anade -es: passes.
Consonante + y -> -ies: tries.

questions.prompt: Completa: My brother ___ (pay) the bills online.
questions.explanation: Vocal + y no cambia: solo se anade -s (pays).

questions.prompt: Completa: The office ___ (do) a lot of paperwork every day.
questions.explanation: 'do' es irregular en 3a persona, igual que 'go': do -> does.
Negativa en 3a persona singular: doesn't + verbo base (like, sin -s).

questions.prompt: Completa (forma negativa): We ___ (not/drive) to work; we take the bus.
questions.explanation: Sujeto plural (we) -> don't + verbo base.

questions.prompt: Completa la pregunta: ___ he speak German?
questions.explanation: Pregunta en 3a persona singular -> Does + sujeto + verbo base.
Cuando 'who' es el sujeto de la pregunta, no se usa do/does; el verbo principal lleva -s como en la afirmativa.

questions.prompt:
Mark plays the piano. (DOES)
Rewrite: ___ the piano?
questions.explanation: Pregunta en presente simple, 3a persona: Does + sujeto + verbo base (sin -s).

questions.prompt:
My cousins live in Canada. (DO)
Rewrite: ___ in Canada?
questions.explanation: Sujeto plural (my cousins) -> Do + sujeto + verbo base, sin -s.

questions.prompt:
She has a laptop. (DOES)
Rewrite: ___ a laptop?
questions.explanation: En preguntas, el verbo principal recupera su forma base (have, no has), porque 'does' ya lleva la marca de 3a persona.

questions.prompt:
My grandmother doesn't drive a car. (NEVER)
Rewrite: My grandmother ___ a car.
questions.explanation: 'Never' ya es negativo, asi que el verbo va en forma afirmativa (drives, 3a persona), no con 'doesn't'.

questions.prompt:
My colleagues never arrive late. (DON'T)
Rewrite: My colleagues ___ late.
questions.explanation: 'Never' ya indica negacion; al usar 'don't' (negacion explicita) el verbo principal vuelve a la base sin 'never'.

questions.prompt:
This machine doesn't need electricity. (DOES)
Rewrite: ___ electricity?
questions.explanation: La pregunta en presente simple usa Does + sujeto + verbo base, aunque el enunciado original fuera negativo.

questions.prompt:
Someone repairs the printers in this office. (WHO)
Rewrite: ___ the printers in this office?
questions.explanation: Cuando 'who' es el sujeto de la pregunta, no se usa do/does; el verbo principal lleva -s (repairs).

questions.prompt:
Something smells strange in the kitchen. (WHAT)
Rewrite: ___ strange in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Cuando 'what' es el sujeto de la pregunta, no se usa do/does; el verbo principal lleva -s (smells).

Accion ahora mismo -> Present Continuous.
'Look!' senala algo que ocurre ahora -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: These days, more and more people ___ from home.
questions.explanation: Tendencia que cambia -> Present Continuous.
Situacion que se desarrolla -> Continuous.
always + Continuous = accion repetida y molesta.

questions.prompt: I ___ a book by Orwell at the moment.
questions.explanation: Situacion temporal alrededor de ahora -> Continuous.
Cambio / evolucion -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: She ___ with her parents until she finds a flat.
questions.explanation: Situacion temporal -> Continuous.
Accion en este momento -> Continuous; orden auxiliar + sujeto + -ing.

questions.prompt: This year prices ___ all the time.
questions.explanation: Cambio en curso (this year) -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: He ___ really hard for his exams this week.
questions.explanation: Periodo temporal (this week) -> Continuous.
'Listen!' -> algo que ocurre ahora -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: The number of tourists ___ at the moment because of the festival.
questions.explanation: 'at the moment' -> Continuous.
'have lunch' es accion -> am/is/are + having.
Silaba consonante-vocal-consonante -> se dobla la consonante: running.
Termina en -e muda -> write -> writing.
Consonante-vocal-consonante -> sitting.
-ie -> -ying: lying.
Consonante-vocal-consonante -> getting.
-e muda -> making.

questions.prompt: Completa: The dog ___ (swim) across the river.
questions.explanation: Consonante-vocal-consonante -> swimming.
La -y se mantiene: studying.
En ingles britanico se dobla la -l: travelling (AmE: traveling).
Negativa: isn't / aren't / 'm not + -ing.
Pregunta: Are + sujeto + -ing.
'At the moment' acompana al Present Continuous.
El adverbio de frecuencia va antes del verbo principal.
'Every night' -> habito -> Present Simple.
Con el verbo 'be' el adverbio va despues: is always.

questions.prompt: Que grupo de palabras indica Present Continuous?
questions.explanation: Marcan una accion en curso.
'These days' + habito actual -> Present Simple (watch).

questions.prompt: Nowadays people ___ more and more attention to health.
questions.explanation: 'Nowadays' + tendencia que cambia -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: Cual tiene el adverbio bien colocado?
questions.explanation: Adverbio de frecuencia antes del verbo principal.
'How often' pregunta por frecuencia -> Present Simple.
Plan futuro acordado -> Present Continuous.

questions.prompt: I ___ get up early on Sundays.
questions.explanation: Adverbio de frecuencia -> Present Simple.
El Continuous pide un marcador de 'ahora'.
'know' es verbo de estado: no va en -ing.
'love' (emocion) es estativo -> Simple.
'belong' (posesion) es estativo.
'want' es estativo -> Present Simple.
'understand' es estativo.
'contain' es estativo (contenido / medida).
'own' (posesion) es estativo.
'seem' es estativo.
'cost' (precio) es estativo.
'prefer' es estativo.
'remember' es estativo.
Aqui 'weigh' expresa una medida -> estativo.
'believe' (opinion) es estativo.
'think' = opinar -> estativo -> Simple.
'think' = reflexionar -> accion -> Continuous.
'have' = poseer -> estativo.
'have a party' = actividad / plan -> Continuous.
'taste' = percepcion -> estativo.
'taste' = accion voluntaria -> Continuous.
'see' = entender / percibir -> estativo.
'see' = tener una cita -> accion / plan -> Continuous.
'be' = conducta puntual -> Continuous (are being silly).
'look' = parecer -> estativo.
'look at' = mirar -> accion -> Continuous.
Medida / estado -> Simple; 'is weighing' seria la accion de pesar en una balanza.

questions.prompt: Normally I ___ at home, but this week I ___ in the office.
questions.explanation: Habito -> Simple; situacion temporal (this week) -> Continuous.
Pregunta por la profesion -> Present Simple.
Accion en este momento -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: My sister ___ usually cook, but tonight she ___ pasta.
questions.explanation: Habito negativo -> Simple; excepcion de esta noche -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: We ___ dinner at 8 every day, but today we ___ early.
questions.explanation: Rutina -> Simple; hoy (excepcion) -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: According to the timetable, the plane ___ at 6 a.m.
questions.explanation: Horario fijo, aunque sea futuro -> Present Simple.
Cita personal acordada -> Present Continuous para el futuro.
Queja por accion repetida -> always + Continuous.

questions.prompt: She ___ from Italy, but right now she ___ in Spain.
questions.explanation: Origen = hecho permanente -> Simple; residencia temporal -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: This year I ___ to eat more vegetables.
questions.explanation: Esfuerzo temporal en curso (this year) -> Continuous.

questions.prompt: Bees ___ honey; look, this one ___ nectar.
questions.explanation: Verdad general -> Simple; accion visible ahora (look) -> Continuous.
Pregunta sobre frecuencia (often) -> Present Simple: Does + it + base.

questions.prompt: Why ___ your coat? Is it cold in here?
questions.explanation: Accion inusual en este momento -> Continuous (vs 'do you wear' = habito).
